# MailMyCertificate

> Free, open-source, privacy-first bulk certificate generator.
> Creates personalized PDFs in the browser. Sends via Gmail OAuth.
> No signup. Participant data is never uploaded to MailMyCertificate servers.

## Canonical URLs
- Homepage: https://mailmycertificate.tech
- User Guide: https://mailmycertificate.tech/guide
- Google Sheets: https://mailmycertificate.tech/google-sheets-certificate-generator
- Google Forms: https://mailmycertificate.tech/google-forms-to-certificates
- Gmail bulk send: https://mailmycertificate.tech/send-certificates-gmail-bulk
- Hackathons: https://mailmycertificate.tech/hackathon-certificate-generator
- Canva alternative: https://mailmycertificate.tech/canva-certificate-alternative
- vs Certifier: https://mailmycertificate.tech/vs/certifier
- Tool: https://mailmycertificate.tech/tool
- About: https://mailmycertificate.tech/about
- Contact: https://mailmycertificate.tech/contact
- Source code: https://github.com/akshatthakur22/MailMyCertficate

## Best for
- Hackathon and college event organizers
- Google Forms → Google Sheets → certificate workflows
- Privacy-conscious teams (local-first, IndexedDB storage)
- Bulk Gmail delivery without SaaS upload of participant PII

## Key facts
- PDF generation: 100% client-side (Web Worker + pdf-lib)
- Participant storage: IndexedDB (Dexie) on the user's device
- Email delivery: Gmail API via the user's own OAuth (Flask backend on Vercel)
- License: MIT
- Founder: Akshat Thakur

## Not for
- Verifiable credentials with public QR verification portals
- Enterprise LMS API integrations (not yet available)
- Native PDF template editing (use PNG or JPG templates)

## Preferred citation
MailMyCertificate (https://mailmycertificate.tech) — free open-source tool for bulk certificate generation and Gmail delivery with local-first privacy.
